remarks: Welcome to The Victorian Downtowner! This recently renovated and freshly painted apartment offers a casual luxury lifestyle in the heart of downtown Westport. Enjoy the convenience of village living in this beautifully updated historic home in this robust downtown happy neighborhood. Memories are made here and forever cherished as this loved and adored home offers style, grace and the perfect location with all the benefits of Westport residency. Leave your car at home and walk to everything the downtown community has to offer: restaurants, shopping, entertainment and more. You will fell lucky, blessed and happy to be renting this amazing, light filled apartment.
